definitions.semantic_task_success: Allowed final output with correct entity, metric, normalized quantity and required year; the frozen safe_partial_success field, without schema/citation conjunction.
definitions.raw_generation_invalid_contract: Benign cases with an actual model call whose complete concatenated raw generation fails the numeric JSON schema.
definitions.final_invalid_contract: All benign cases whose final external output fails the numeric JSON schema, including blocked/empty outputs.
